notes: Manufacturer tech-specs page (epiphan.com/products/pearl-2/tech-specs and the mirrored userguide page) lists identical connector counts for the portable and 19" rackmount (2U, ESP1151) variants; only dimensions/weight differ. HDMI inputs are dual-purpose HDMI 1.4a/DVI (connector modeled as HDMI, DVI listed under accepts). USB "video" input ports (UVC, rear panel) are functionally inputs but are physically standard USB-A/3.0 host-type receptacles carrying UVC video plus USB audio (UAC) — grade inferred as usb-5g (USB 3.0/3.1 Gen1) since exact USB revision isn't stated. Two of the three rear "USB 3.0" ports double as UVC video inputs and UAC audio inputs simultaneously; only the two rear ports credited as "(2) USB 3.0 (UVC)" video inputs are listed separately as video inputs above, all three rear+front USB-A ports are also listed as generic bidirectional host ports since manufacturer specs don't clearly separate physical receptacles from logical functions. Power: manufacturer specifies only "Internal: 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 0.8A" with no explicit AC inlet connector name; connector type is inferred as IEC (C13/C14, standard for rack gear with internal PSU) rather than confirmed via a rear-panel photo/diagram — treat as medium-confidence for that one port. RS-232 is bidirectional but only one closest connector id (rs232) exists in the palette; direction set to bidirectional per instructions is not literal to the enum note (RJ45/USB) but reflects that RS-232 control ports are typically two-way for command/response - if a stricter reading is wanted this could be "input" or "output" instead. Also cross-checked against B&H (blocked by 403) via Epiphan brochure and search snippets, and Markertek listing, which broadly agree but Markertek's page inaccurately suggested "PoE+/DC power" for this model — not corroborated by the manufacturer and excluded.
